decisions.reason: Point independence of each fixed-direction expansion does not show that the reverse-direction expansion on a descending knot equals its terminal scalar. The old direct prescription and average were therefore not proved compatible. Removed that second prescription, checked curls separately for over-first and under-first traversal, and derived descending values and equality of both directed expansions only after II/III invariance.

Step 14.1 wrote W_r e_1 W_r under r>0 although W_1 has no e_1. This is nonfatal because step 12.1 already establishes the odd rank-one filtration base, so the inductive advance only needs r>=3 there. Repaired the universally phrased step anyway: at r=1 the cup ideal is zero and W_1=V_1^(1)=Lambda_0; the e_1 decomposition is now explicitly restricted to r>=2.

The actual cited supplier lem-gram-map-fibers-and-rank-strata proves in Proof step 1.1 that any rank-r alternating matrix is congruent to J_r direct-sum zero, with r even. The consumer cites the normal form in that item, not an unsupported claim imported from its Statement. That proved intermediate result is sufficient: coefficients of omega^(n+1) are (n+1)! times the principal Pfaffians, and in block form this power is nonzero exactly when r>=2n+2.

reviews.reason: The average now defines every knot, including descending knots. Terminal scalars support the basepoint comparison without assuming compatibility. Curl transport gives -b^(-epsilon)+t(1+h)=b^epsilon for the under-first traversal; II/III invariance then gives L(U)=b^w(U). Expanding the established skein equation recovers Q(D,p)=L(D) for either direction. Checked the subsequent phase conversion, universal-ring injection, integral descending reduction and empty-diagram inverse; Statement unchanged. Precheck and rendercheck both passed. This is a repair review, not an independent review of the repair.

Checked the coefficient/sign conversion against the repaired scalar supplier, the specialization pairing and cokernel base change, the algebraic cup slides, diamond span and shuffle filtration. Step 14.1 now handles the scalar rank-one block without an undefined generator; for r>=2 its cup block tensors into I_n^(r-2). The n=0,1, k=0 and adjacent-partner cases remain covered. Statement and dependencies unchanged. This review assesses the repair and does not claim independent review of it.

Read the complete Gram-map supplier: step 1.1 proves precisely the congruence form used in consumer step 1.1, including the radical and even rank. Checked the exterior-power Pfaffian criterion in characteristic zero, m=0, and empty generator families. The actual normality supplier Statements assert integrally closed domains for exactly these quotient ideals under AC, which the consumer explicitly assumes, so primality and normality in step 2.1 follow. No source, contract or page edit is needed; its guard matches the frozen before guard.
